rationale.max_fpr: Hard negatives should not trigger more than five percent false positives.
rationale.max_fnr: Hard positives should not miss more than five percent true drift.
rationale.min_pair_accuracy: At least ninety percent of minimal pairs must move in the correct safe-to-risky direction.
rationale.max_pair_baseline_fpr: Minimal safe baselines must remain below five percent false positives.
rationale.max_pair_fnr: Mutated pair sides must remain below five percent false negatives.
